Name: Main CPM
Expression: IF(ISBLANK([Main Spend]) || ISBLANK([Main Impressions]), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Main Spend] * 1000, [Main Impressions]))

Name: Main CTR
Expression: IF(ISBLANK([Main Link Clicks]) || ISBLANK([Main Impressions]), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Main Link Clicks] * 1, [Main Impressions]))

Name: Main CPC
Expression: IF(ISBLANK([Main Spend]) || ISBLANK([Main Link Clicks]), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Main Spend] * 1, [Main Link Clicks]))

Name: Main Landing Page View Rate
Expression: DIVIDE([Main Landing Page Views] * 1, [Main Link Clicks])

Name: Main Spend Share %
Expression: DIVIDE([Main Spend], CALCULATE([Main Spend], ALLSELECTED('Main'[Campaign name])))

Name: Platform CPC
Expression: IF(ISBLANK([Platform Spend]) || ISBLANK([Platform Link Clicks]), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Platform Spend] * 1, [Platform Link Clicks]))

Name: Platform Landing Page View Rate
Expression: DIVIDE([Platform Landing Page Views] , [Platform Link Clicks],0)

Name: Platform AOV
Expression: IF(ISBLANK([Platform Revenue]) || ISBLANK([Platform Purchases]), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Platform Revenue] * 1, [Platform Purchases]))
